title: Black Ops II Zombies × CS2 Loadouts
tagline: A BO2 Zombies co-op mashup (2-4 players) that pulls CS2 weapon audio and loadouts from your installed CS2 folder. Runs via T6SP-Mod / GSC loader — no VAC interaction.
description: Launch Black Ops II Zombies with custom GSC scripts that apply Counter-Strike 2 weapon sounds, loadout picker (AK-47 / M4A4), and economy overlay. The mod reads CS2's installed folder for assets only — it never loads anything into CS2, so there's no anti-cheat risk. Multiplayer co-op for 2-4 friends. First version includes one custom Zombies map, two active loadouts, and basic economy UI. Built from sheets: weapons, loadouts, systems, preflight clean.
required_games: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
credits: Design and sheets: user and assistant. Engine: IW Engine (BO2). Assets source: Counter-Strike 2 (Valve). Loader concept: T6SP-Mod / BO2 Mod Manager community. Build: React launcher (this version).
license: MIT (project files); game assets remain property of Valve / Activision. This mashup does not distribute any game files.
remix_choice: Remix allowed from sheets (JSON). Original game assets may not be redistributed by others.
